title: Evidence: Sofa Condition Photos

attachments.platform_description: Close-up of the right armrest showing a linear scratch approximately 2 inches long. The scratch is a surface abrasion affecting the top leather finish layer. No penetration to leather substrate visible. Visible from normal seating distance.

attachments.platform_description: Left seat cushion showing a lighter-toned area relative to surrounding leather. Color variation is consistent with patina from regular sitting use. No tears, stains, or structural damage visible.

attachments.platform_description: Full-length view of 96-inch brown leather sofa in a residential setting. General condition consistent with a used leather sofa. Cushions intact with normal compression. Frame straight, all legs present and stable.

attachments.platform_description: Close-up of seat cushion leather surface. Micro-creasing and softening consistent with regular sitting use. Leather grain intact. No cracks, peeling, or finish loss visible.

submitted_text:
While the listing mentioned some wear, seeing it in person is very different from photos. The overall condition is significantly more worn than what "Good" condition implies. At this price point, I expected the sofa to look nearly new.
